summary: This round rebases the change onto a new merge-base without changing its content. `exeRollout.sh` now calls `pull_on_guest` instead of `docker save`/`docker load`, and it still copies the app-sandbox scripts before `exeTemplate.sh` runs. The image is on the guest before `appSandboxSetup.sh` uses it to pack the SDK, and `remove_unused_images` only removes `halo-workspace` repository tags and dangling images, so it does not touch the pinned node image. The other files only have shifted offsets; all temp tests pass, every changed line is covered or has an accepted exemption, and no P0 or P1 finding remains.
